product_metadata.title: J H Heat Resistant Oven Glove:EN407 Certified 932 °F, 2 Layers Silicone Coating, Oven Mitts for Cooking, Kitchen, Camping, Fireplace, Grilling, 1 Pair
features: New Generation Hot Resistant Glove Exclusive Quadruple Heat Protection Technology: New Design of thickened 2 layers silicone coating. 1 Layer of Black Dupont Nomex & Kevlar Heat Resistant Fiber + 2 Layers of Heat Resistant Silicone coating on the shell Contain 1 Layer Black/ Yellow silicone block coating and 1 Layer transparent silicone on full palm coating. 1 Layer of 100% Cotton Liner.
Food-grade Silicone Coating with nonslip grip texture, handling food and slippery items, not a problem.
Reversible for left or right hand. mitten bulky fit, easy in and out.
Make by Nomex, heat-and flame-resistant fiber, the same material used to build firefighter suits, extreme heat resistant. Quality cotton lining for perspiration free.
Apply to kitchen, oven, grill, barbecue, fireplace and heat/fire resistant purpose.
